sentences.text: Umesh Kumar Mahto ...... Petitioner

Versus
 1. The State of Jharkhand
 2. Sharmila Kumari ......Opposite parties

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
-----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Ranjan Sahay, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Lily Sahay, A.P.P. For the O.P.
No.2 : Mr. Sourabh Kumar Das, Advocate .....
Order No.05/ Dated:20.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Mahila Thana Bundu P.S. Case No. 01 of 2022
corresponding to G.R. No. 1590 of 2022 instituted under Sections 498A, 313, 323, 341, 34 of the
Indian Penal Code and 3/4 Dp. Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of
anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R, there is an allegation that accused person threatened the informant to murder her and always used to assault her.
It is further alleged that additional dowry of Rs. 5 lakhs and household items were demanded from her.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that petitioner is the husband and there was no demand of additional dowry and he never tortured the informant for any means nor assaulted her.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of granting anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
It appears that petitioner has complied with the notice issued under Section 41(A) Cr.p.c. and participated in the investigation.
Investigation has been completed and petitioner is not required for the purpose of investigation of the case.
I.O. has been directed to file charge sheet against the petitioner for the offence under Section 498(A) and 341 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid aspects of the case, the nature of allegation coupled with materials on record, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M., Ranchi in connection with Mahila Thana Bundu P.S. Case No. 01 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 1590 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
